description: The Garden Ikoyi is a nature-first urban sanctuary designed to reconnect Lagosians with calm, culture, and community. Set in the heart of Ikoyi, it blends horticulture, dining, creativity, and wellness in an open, green environment intentionally crafted for meaningful experiences. From thoughtfully curated gardens to serene seating areas, nature-inspired events, family activities, and cultural programming, The Garden Ikoyi offers a rare escape from the intensity of Lagos. It serves as a gathering place for families, professionals, artists, and visitors seeking tranquility, connection, and inspiration. Operated with a commitment to environmental mindfulness and public value, The Garden Ikoyi revitalizes the concept of outdoor living in Lagos — proving that urban spaces can be beautiful, functional, restorative, and community-centered.

At the core of our business is the determination to provide the best possible dining solution to our clients.

The indistinctly lit interior with a decor reminiscent of Victorian comfort gives off that home feel and sets the mood for a great evening highlighted by live games, sumptuous drinks, and beautiful music. The music is carefully selected by their resident DJ’s, starting off with a laid-back soulful lounge music and growing into a more up-tempo and party setting tunes. A perfect blend of old favorite and recent jams. The bar boasts a wide variety of fine Irish or Scottish whiskies, smooth cognacs to suit all tastes, a great wine list for the different palates, a selection of cocktails ranging from popular classics to innovative signature home exclusive, and the best of your favorite champagnes. The kitchen displays the diversity of local cuisine and offers sumptuous local meals from across the federation. The grill offers bar friendly chops as well as various grilled meals.

Operating Hours

Mon - Sat: 9am - 5am; Sun: 5pm - 5am

We offer catering for events and private parties; as well as pre-prepped food packs for our customers to take away, allowing them to make the best food as easily as possible when they want it in the comfort of their homes.

RK Cafe Catering service, specializes in making events easy, memorable and extraordinary! Using only the highest quality ingredients, our menu items are expertly prepared by our chefs. No size is too big or small! We are proud to create delicious meals from diverse cuisines, made from the freshest ingredients—at affordable prices, whether you eat in, take out or enjoy it at one of our catered events. name: Pizza Hut
location: 156 Awolowo Rd, Ikoyi 101233, Lagos
description:
The Pizza Hut Story begins in May 1958. Dan and Frank Carney opened their 550-square foot Pizza restaurant in Wichita, Kansas.

Dan and Frank, with friends Richard Beemer and John Bender, made the Pizza themselves. 

What was created was innovative, high quality and engaging, an informal eating experience that thrived on the involvement of the buzzing community. Pizza Hut has grown rapidly and become well known for its famous "Pan Pizza" the product, with a thicker crust made in deep pans that have stolen the hearts of pizza lovers the world over.

Now proudly available in Ikoyi, Nigeria you too can enjoy the best pizza's on earth!

name: The Autobiography
location: KM 34, LEKKI-EPE EXPRESSWAY, SANGOTEDO, LEKKI, LAGOS
description:
The Autobiography is an upscale, elitist lounge with a bias for the propagation of positive African history, ancestry, and heritage through the instrumentality of music, art, cuisine, and literature.

We celebrate people of black ancestry, both known and unknown, living or dead,
who had or have made a mark on the African continent or elsewhere. Furthermore,
patrons of the Autobiography shall be subtly informed of very unique positive facts
about Africa and the African heritage, in a manner which is relaxed and not too
academic, in order to ensure the information is absorbed effortlessly by the
patrons.

The dissemination of these positive vibes about Africa, its ancestry, heritage and
people shall be done through music, cuisine, events, paintings, pictures and
literature (displayed on television screens in the lounge), all geared towards
projecting the African image and showcasing its rich cultural heritage as well as
the accomplishments of persons of African ancestry. The whole idea is to tell the
story of Africa and its people from a positive perspective and shift the paradigm
from the single pervasive story of a dark continent whose people are inferior,
without history and generally degenerate.

It is pertinent to note that the Autobiography does not strive to create any form of
segregation or dichotomy between Africa and the rest of the world, rather, the
idea is to help both Africans and non-Africans alike, see the positives about Africa
which would, hopefully, lead to a change in the way African is generally perceived.

While we are aware that information on African heritage already exist in different
forms, the Autobiography seeks to serve these facts and information to its patrons
in a relaxed, fun and not-too-academic environment in order to make for easier
assimilation of these facts with little or no exertion.

In conclusion, having an African theme at the Autobiography, like the name
implies, is to present the story of Africa or its biography, in a manner which
engenders Africa’s inclusion in the grand scheme of things in the world rather than
its exclusion, usually shrouded in a toga of pariah status.

Our brownies also contain four superfoods so you can tap into that super-natural goodness to boost your health and day.

description:

A great option for those who have plenty of time to eat some good food before a flight, or if you live and work in Ikeja. They offer continental food and sushi specials, as well as a fully stocked coffee shop and bar. They can deliver to you if you don’t want to sit in traffic to get to them.

They also have some of the best steaks in town. If you miss the English grub then they will satisfy your cravings.

name: Jazzhole
location: 168 Awolowo Road
description:
Jazzhole has been a favorite with book and music enthusiasts around Lagos for years. A bookshop, cafe and record shop (they actually sell old records and CDs), that has an oldies feel to it that cant really be described. An aesthetic music store that started out in the 80′s with an ambience that sinks music and literature through the soul. Their walls are painted with jewel cases; the products of geniuses. Home to all radio formats. Be your own D.J at the Jazz Hole, nothing is conventional there; control the mixers, pump up the volume. Layers of vinyl’s scattered down on the ground, with no pressure from the new generation. It seems ancient, maybe medieval with books on the subject and music from kings and bus drivers in Lagos, touring through Cuba, way up North America, the Islands and Eastern Europe; it stretches out across the West. Real World Music. You’ll find a little something for everyone. So sit back with a cup of coffee from their cafe and enjoy your surroundings.

Operating Hours -

Monday - Saturday : 9am - 8pm

Sunday - open on show days
